composer-2.5-fast.concept: Rotate gutter segments to steer a summer downpour away from a flooding basement — each swipe snaps a pipe ninety degrees before the cellar level rises.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one dry cellar by round's end feels like beating the storm.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: rain volume spikes and leaf debris clogs random junctions mid-round.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: ink-wash watercolor storm clouds over grey rooftops

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap the valleys on a live compute-pricing graph to spin up phone agents only during off-peak dips — fake spikes punish mistimed taps.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on price-graph valleys, hold through sustained dips
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: stack cheap agent launches in sixty seconds of shrinking off-peak windows.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: price curves grow noisier and decoy dips multiply each wave.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal green waveforms on matte black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick gold coins loose from a crumbling plaster wall before mortar re-seals the cracks — heavier coins need longer flicks.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: flick and drag to pry coins from wall slots
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: haul maximum loot before the wall hardens shut.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: plaster sets faster and hidden bricks deflect weak flicks.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Trace and sever branching deserialization chains before they complete a gadget loop — drag through nodes to cut the path before Ruby executes.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to trace and slash connection paths between nodes
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: defuse one chain cleanly per thirty-second round.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: chains fork faster with decoy nodes that explode on wrong cuts.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: glitchy wireframe ruby-red on dark terminal
